content: {"summary":"Readiness uses MAXSS(dest=quotient,src=0.05) then UCOMISS/JBE; <=, equal, and unordered take A2. Event byte +0x11 executes only on the 76dc path, not 76e0. Payload +0x10 controls dispatch; scheduling +8 does not control the final formula.","observations":[{"id":"O1","claim":"MAXSS operand order: AT&T maxss %xmm7,%xmm1 means destination xmm1=quotient, source xmm7=0.05. The exact edge from 77bd/782f to A4/A6 is not in these slices.","refs":["A4:L1-L2","A5:L13-L17","A6:L1-L3","A7:L4-L8"]},{"id":"O10","claim":"Previous 'unordered readiness applies' is rejected as an emission claim: unordered JBE goes to A2 accumulation.
